description:
Majestic Noe Valley Queen Anne Victorian Residence Artfully uniting classic style with contemporary luxury 4250 23rd Street is custom made for those who appreciate quality craftsmanship, modern conveniences and an idyllic location. Built in 1893 by architect Wm. Mooser, this home is one of a kind. The main level includes grand proportions from soaring ceilings to oversized rooms. The gracious formal dining room, expansive living room with gas fireplace and state-of-the-art chef’s kitchen have been custom designed. The main level is completed with a breakfast room, powder room, and a spectacular master bedroom suite. Descend the grand staircase to discover 4 bedrooms, 2 baths, a family room, and laundry room. Adjoining the spacious family room is a second master suite which can be combined to create au-pair quarters. Each bedroom has a unique view of the home’s lush, verdant landscaping. The home’s large attic provides abundant storage and an opportunity to explore expansion potential. Distinctively located in the heart of Noe Valley. 
*Square Footage is approximate per artist's drawing
